errors.text_span: През 2014 и 2015 година стойността спада до 110.579 и 114.566 хил. лв. съответно
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the value drops in both 2014 and 2015. The chart shows that the value drops to 110.579 in 2014 and then rises to 114.566 in 2015.

errors.text_span: след което има ново нарастване до 112.844 хил. лв. в 2016
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states there is an increase to 112.844 in 2016. The chart shows a decrease from 114.566 in 2015 to 112.844 in 2016.
The line style for the second series is described as 'dotted' (пунктирана), but the figure shows a dashed line, not a dotted one.
The description incorrectly groups the value for 2016 (47.421) as part of a continuous drop. The chart shows that the value actually increases from 46.466 in 2015 to 47.421 in 2016.
The phrasing is ambiguous and does not explicitly state that the value decreases from 2017 to 2018. It just states the value for 2018 after describing an increase in 2017.
